title: What Would You Do In My Little Pony World?
description: Answer 12 magical questions to see what you’d do in the world of My Little Pony!

questions.text: A new pony arrives in town feeling lonely. You...

options.text: Invite them to join a big group activity right away
Approach gently and have a quiet, kind chat
Show them around and point out useful places
Imagine all the fun adventures you could have together

questions.text: A friendship problem breaks out between friends. You...

options.text: Help everyone express their feelings calmly
Look at the situation fairly and find a solution
Guide them to talk things through step by step
Let them work it out in their own time and way

questions.text: You discover a hidden magical place. You...

options.text: Gather friends to explore it together excitedly
Visit quietly and enjoy its peace alone
Notice small details and beautiful surroundings
Wonder about its secrets and magical history

questions.text: Friends want to plan a big celebration. You...

options.text: Help organize and make sure everything runs smoothly
Go with the flow and add fun ideas as you go
Focus on making everyone feel happy and welcome
Think about what’s practical and easy to manage

questions.text: A spell goes wrong and causes chaos. You...

options.text: Gather everyone to fix it together quickly
Stay calm and figure out how to fix it quietly
Deal with the real problems right in front of you
Think of creative ways to reverse the magic

questions.text: You have to choose a special mission. You...

options.text: Pick one that lets you work with a team
Prefer a mission you can complete on your own
Choose one with clear, practical goals
Pick something mysterious and full of possibility

questions.text: Someone needs help with a difficult task. You...

options.text: Jump in and help right away with energy
Help quietly without needing attention
Show them a simple, effective way to do it
Come up with a smarter, creative way to finish

questions.text: Your favorite pony activity gets canceled. You...

options.text: Suggest a fun new plan to cheer everyone up
Feel better once you have a new schedule
Care about how disappointed everyone feels
Understand why and accept it calmly

questions.text: You find a lost magical creature. You...

options.text: Ask friends to help you look for its home
Calm it down and care for it gently alone
Notice what it needs to feel safe and comfortable
Imagine where it might have come from

questions.text: Friends can’t agree on an activity. You...

options.text: Listen to everyone and understand their feelings
Suggest a fair choice that makes sense
Propose a clear decision so you can start
Let everyone take turns choosing what to do

questions.text: You’re given a special magical talent. You...

options.text: Use it to bring joy to as many as possible
Use it quietly to help those you care about
Use it to solve real, everyday problems
Use it to inspire hope and big dreams

questions.text: A storm threatens the town. You...

options.text: Work with the whole town to prepare together
Prepare your own space and help neighbors quietly
Focus on securing things and staying safe
Think ahead about how to help afterward

questions.text: You have to give a speech in front of everypony. You...

options.text: Feel excited to speak and inspire everypony
Feel nervous but speak gently from the heart
Stick to clear, honest points everyone understands
Speak warmly about friendship and caring for each other

questions.text: A friend wants to try something risky. You...

options.text: Join them to make sure they stay safe
Warn them quietly and express your concern
Explain the risks honestly and directly
Tell them how much you care about their well-being

questions.text: You’re choosing a home in Ponyville. You...

options.text: Pick one close to friends and busy areas
Choose a quiet, peaceful spot away from crowds
Arrange it neatly and keep things organized
Decorate freely and make it cozy and relaxed

questions.text: A lesson about friendship needs to be taught. You...

options.text: Lead a fun group activity to teach it
Share the idea quietly with one friend at a time
Teach it with real examples and stories
Explain its meaning and why it matters

questions.text: You accidentally hurt a friend’s feelings. You...

options.text: Apologize right away and try to fix it
Feel sorry and talk to them privately sincerely
Think clearly about what you should do next
Express how sorry you are from your heart

questions.text: A big festival is coming up. You...

options.text: Help plan every part ahead of time
Wait and join in when it’s ready
Make sure every detail is practical and works
Dream up fun surprises and creative moments

questions.text: You meet a pony who’s very different from you. You...

options.text: Be friendly and curious about their life
Observe quietly and respect their differences
Find common things you both enjoy doing
Enjoy learning new perspectives from them

questions.text: You have to finish an important task quickly. You...

options.text: Get others to help you finish faster
Focus quietly until you get it done
Make a simple plan and follow it carefully
Work in your own way until it’s finished

questions.text: A friend shares a secret dream with you. You...

options.text: Encourage them excitedly and support them
Keep it safe and support them gently
Help them think of real steps to reach it
Believe in their dream and imagine it coming true

questions.text: Two friends are being stubborn. You...

options.text: Help them talk openly until they understand
Speak to each one privately to understand them
Look for a fair solution that makes sense
Help them see how much their friendship matters

questions.text: You find a mysterious old book. You...

options.text: Read it with friends and discuss it together
Read it alone and think about its meaning
Study its details and facts carefully
Wonder about its stories and hidden magic

questions.text: Your friends want to go on an adventure. You...

options.text: Pack quickly and get excited right away
Plan the route and bring necessary supplies
Enjoy the real beautiful places you visit
Imagine all the amazing things you might find

questions.text: A pony is being treated unfairly. You...

options.text: Speak up for them openly and bravely
Support them quietly and stand by them
Stand up for what’s fair and logical
Feel deeply for them and show you care

questions.text: You’re feeling tired and overwhelmed. You...

options.text: Spend time with friends to feel better
Take quiet time alone to rest and recharge
Finish small tasks to feel in control again
Do something fun and light to relax

questions.text: You want to make a new friend smile. You...

options.text: Plan a fun surprise to cheer them up
Leave a kind note and give them space
Help them with something they need done
Tell them something hopeful and meaningful

questions.text: A rule doesn’t seem fair to everypony. You...

options.text: Talk with others about changing it together
Think quietly about how to make it better
Look at why it exists and if it still works
Think about how it makes everypony feel

questions.text: You’re in charge of a fun group game. You...

options.text: Make sure everyone joins in and has fun
Explain quietly and let shy ponies join gently
Follow the rules clearly and fairly
Keep it loose and enjoy the playful energy

questions.text: A friend achieves something amazing. You...

options.text: Celebrate loudly and tell everyone proudly
Congratulate them sincerely and quietly
Admire how hard they worked to succeed
Feel inspired by their big accomplishment

questions.text: You have to choose between two good things. You...

options.text: Ask friends what they think you should do
Think quietly and trust your own choice
Choose what makes the most practical sense
Choose what feels right in your heart

questions.text: Nightmare Night is here. You...

options.text: Join all the spooky fun with friends
Enjoy the cozy parts and avoid scares
Make sure everything is safe and fun
Go along with whatever feels exciting

questions.text: A friend needs honest advice. You...

options.text: Tell them openly but with kindness
Speak softly and choose your words carefully
Be clear and direct about what you think
Be gentle and focus on their feelings

questions.text: You see beauty in something small. You...

options.text: Show it to friends so they can enjoy it too
Keep it to yourself and enjoy the quiet moment
Notice its details and real beauty
Feel inspired by its simple magic

questions.text: The day ends and you look back. You...

options.text: Feel happy about the friends you spent time with
Feel calm about the quiet moments you had
Feel good about what you accomplished
Feel glad you enjoyed the day freely

questions.text: Your idea of true friendship magic is...

options.text: Laughing, sharing, and being together
Understanding, listening, and being kind
Loyalty, honesty, and being reliable
Care, warmth, and supporting each other

results.title: Twilight Sparkle
results.description: You’d learn, lead, and solve problems with wisdom! You’re curious, organized, and value friendship deeply. You’re an INFJ—insightful, responsible, and full of care.

results.title: Pinkie Pie
results.description: You’d bring joy, fun, and laughter everywhere! You love parties, surprises, and making everypony smile. You’re an ESFP—energetic, warm, and full of life.

results.title: Rainbow Dash
results.description: You’d be bold, fast, and loyal to your friends! You love adventure, challenges, and staying true to yourself. You’re an ESTP—brave, spontaneous, and dependable.

results.title: Rarity
results.description: You’d create beauty, kindness, and special moments! You’re generous, creative, and care deeply about others. You’re an ENFJ—charming, warm, and inspiring.

results.title: Fluttershy
results.description: You’d care gently, help quietly, and love deeply! You’re kind, calm, and brave when it matters. You’re an ISFP—gentle, creative, and full of quiet strength.

results.title: Applejack
results.description: You’d work hard, stay honest, and help everyone! You’re reliable, down-to-earth, and loyal to those you love. You’re an ISTJ—practical, steady, and true.

results.title: Starlight Glimmer
results.description: You’d grow, learn, and help friends understand each other! You’re thoughtful, logical, and always improving. You’re an INTP—curious, calm, and wise.

results.title: Spike
results.description: You’d support, help, and be loyal to those you love! You’re kind, dependable, and always there for friends. You’re an ISFJ—caring, gentle, and reliable.

results.title: Princess Celestia
results.description: You’d guide, lead, and spread kindness and wisdom! You’re calm, wise, and inspire hope in others. You’re an ENFJ—compassionate, graceful, and visionary.

results.title: Princess Luna
results.description: You’d understand dreams, feelings, and quiet magic! You’re deep, creative, and care for those in the dark. You’re an INFP—imaginative, kind, and full of heart.

results.title: Shining Armor
results.description: You’d protect, lead, and stand for family and friends! You’re brave, responsible, and loyal. You’re an ESTJ—steady, protective, and reliable.

results.title: Cadance
results.description: You’d spread love, joy, and kindness everywhere! You’re warm, loving, and make every moment brighter. You’re an ESFJ—affectionate, social, and kind.

results.title: Discord
results.description: You’d bring fun, chaos, and creative surprises! You’re clever, unique, and have a big heart. You’re an ENTP—witty, imaginative, and full of fun.

results.title: Trixie
results.description: You’d shine, perform, and share your spirit! You’re confident, expressive, and full of energy. You’re an ENFP—creative, bold, and full of heart.

results.title: Zecora
results.description: You’d give wisdom, help, and quiet guidance! You’re calm, mysterious, and deeply kind. You’re an INTJ—insightful, independent, and wise.

results.title: Big Macintosh
results.description: You’d help quietly, work hard, and stand strong! You’re steady, reliable, and kind without many words. You’re an ISTP—calm, practical, and strong.
